dialog.theabyss.rift.info.switch: You can now switch between the Rift Of Sins and the world of the living by pressing %s.
dialog.theabyss.rift.call.2: There you are. I can feel the rings on your hand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.call.3: You have carried them long enough. Come.
dialog.theabyss.rift.arrival.1: Welcome to the Rift Of Sins.
dialog.theabyss.rift.arrival.2: Do not be afraid of the smoke. It only keeps what you leave behind.
dialog.theabyss.rift.arrival.3: Come up to me. I am waiting by the throne.
dialog.theabyss.rift.nudge.1: Up the stairs. I will not come down to you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.nudge.2: The longer you stand there, the louder they get.
dialog.theabyss.rift.nudge.3: Come up. We do not have much time.
dialog.theabyss.rift.void.1: Careful. Nothing falls out of here. Not even you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.open.1: Closer. Let me look at you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.open.2: Yes. The hand has already chosen you. Good.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.who.1: A name would only lie to you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.who.2: Look at my face long enough and you will know it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.who.3: For now, call me the one who warns you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.where.1: Between your world and the Abyss. Every sin falls through here on its way down.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.where.2: The travelers before you stood right where you stand now. Before they forgot who they were.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.why.1: Because you are the first in a long time who might reach him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.why.2: The one who walks with the black blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.1: Long ago, travelers came to the Abyss, just like you. They bound Somnium into rings and learned to shape it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.2: Then he came. A blade in the dark, with eyes of cyan light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.3: He tore the border open and made the Abyss his hunting ground.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.4: Every creature you have slain down there was a traveler once. He made them what they are.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.5: The light in the roots, the hunger in your hand. He planted all of it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.believe.1: You do not have to believe me. Believe your hand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.believe.2: It has been whispering his name for a while now, has it not?
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.stop.1: He is waiting. He wants you weak and tired when you finally meet.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.stop.2: I will not let that happen.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.want.1: I want him gone. And you are the only one who can still walk where he walks.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.understand.1: I cannot fight him myself. I am not what I was.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.understand.2: But I can give you something. A blessing. And if it does not suit you, come back and I will give you another.
dialog.theabyss.rift.c.more.1: Undying. When death reaches for you, it will close its hand on nothing. Once, and then it has to wait.
dialog.theabyss.rift.c.more.2: Strength. Your blows will land like his. Nothing down there will stand for long.
dialog.theabyss.rift.c.more.3: Night. The dark will hide nothing from you anymore. And it will start to hide you instead.
dialog.theabyss.rift.c.time.1: Then go. The rift will wait. So will I.
dialog.theabyss.rift.c.return.1: You came back. Have you decided?
dialog.theabyss.rift.confirm.undying: The Blessing Of Undying. Are you certain?
dialog.theabyss.rift.confirm.strength: The Blessing Of Strength. Are you certain?
dialog.theabyss.rift.confirm.night: The Blessing Of Night. Are you certain?
dialog.theabyss.rift.chosen.2: Can you feel it? That is how it begins.
dialog.theabyss.rift.chosen.3: Go back now. Find his altar.
dialog.theabyss.rift.chosen.4: And when you face him, do not listen to a single word he says.
dialog.theabyss.rift.after.1: The blessing holds. I can see it in your eyes.
dialog.theabyss.rift.after.2: Have you found his altar yet?
dialog.theabyss.rift.after.3: Do not stay too long. The smoke starts to like you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.after.4: Every time you come here, you look a little more like me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.hit.1: That is not how this works.
dialog.theabyss.rift.hit.2: You cannot hurt what you are looking at.
dialog.theabyss.rift.leave.before: Leaving already? You will come back. They always do.
dialog.theabyss.rift.leave.after: Go. He is waiting for you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.1: The deep has turned in its sleep. Come down to me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.overgrowth.1: Stop fighting it. Your heart already knows the rhythm.
dialog.theabyss.rift.overgrowth.2: Listen. It beats slower when you stop resisting.
dialog.theabyss.rift.overgrowth.3: The colours were never yours to keep.
dialog.theabyss.rift.overgrowth.4: Lie down. The roots are warm, and they remember you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.2: Something you did is still echoing in the roots. Come, and I will tell you what it means.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.3: The smoke is restless. It carries your name. Come.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.intro.1: There is ink on your hands that is not yours.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.intro.2: Black ink. Pressed so deep into the page that the words bleed through to the other side.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.intro.3: The deep does not write. The roots do not write. Only one thing down there still holds a pen.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q1.1: The one who walks with the black blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q1.2: He cannot follow you across the border. So he follows your words instead, and hides his own between them.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q1.3: He writes while you dream. Every black line is a hand reaching for you through the dark.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.black.q2: He says I should stay away.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q2.2: Every light that ever crossed into the Abyss heard the same words from him. Stay away. Turn back. Forget.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q2.3: The ones who listened are still on the other side, waiting for a door that never opens again.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q2.4: The ones who did not listen are standing where you stand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q3.1: Because black is all that is left in him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q3.2: Once the cyan ran through his veins the way it runs through yours. He cut it out, vein by vein, and let it soak into the ground.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.black.q3.3: What remained was hollow and dark. He writes with what he has.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.intro.1: The wolf did not look at your blade. It looked at your hand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.intro.2: It knew that light. Long ago it followed light like that across the border, at the heel of one who came before.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.intro.3: Now it has found the light again. At the end of your blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q1.1: It walked beside one who crossed, in the first age of the border.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q1.2: They went deep together. Deeper than anyone should. And the black blade found them there.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q1.3: He did not end them. He let the dark keep them, until the one forgot the wolf and the wolf forgot itself.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q1.4: What you met down there was the forgetting, still wearing fur.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q2.1: What they were has sunk below the roots. Nothing climbs back from there.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q2.2: But the blade that sent them down still walks.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q2.3: End it, and no other light will sink. Not theirs. Not yours.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q3.1: Count the shadows that hunt in the lowlands. Count the eyes in the deep caves.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q3.2: Every one of them crossed the border once, carrying a little light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wolf.q3.3: Every one of them met him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.intro.1: You stood beneath the glowing roots and did not run.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.intro.2: They felt you. They leaned toward you, as they lean toward every light that has not yet gone out.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.intro.3: Few who cross ever stand there that long. The roots remember the ones who do.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.roots.q1: What is the light in the roots?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q1.1: The first light. Older than the Abyss itself.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q1.2: In the beginning it flowed through all of it. Stone, water, beast and dream. The whole deep shone.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q1.3: Then the black blade came and drove it down, below the stone, below the silence.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q1.4: The roots are what still reaches upward. Still searching for the ones who will set it free.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q2.3: No. That was the deep, breathing. It breathes when it is near something it wants.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q2.4: You felt it in your hand first. You will always feel it there first.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.roots.q3: Should I stay away from them?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q3.1: Everything in the Abyss wants to tear you, freeze you, or swallow you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q3.2: Only the roots want to hold you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.roots.q3.3: Sit beneath them when you are weary. Close your eyes. Let them show you what the deep looked like before the blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.intro.1: You emptied yourself once. Every drop of Somnium, cast away into the dark.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.intro.2: The world went grey at its edges. Your hands went cold. And in the hollow you left behind, something answered.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.intro.3: You heard me then. Before I had a face.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q1.1: I am the warmth beneath the cold.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q1.2: I am the light that guided your feet when the lantern died. The breath that stayed in you when the blow should have ended it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q1.3: I have walked beside you since your first step across the border. Only now have you looked at me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.voice.q2: You said someone broke this world.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q2.1: The Abyss was whole once. One dream, one light, one breath.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q2.2: Then the black blade cut it. Into the cold place and the deep caves, into the lowlands and the drowning seas.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q2.3: Every dark corner of the Abyss is a wound of that blade. You have walked through all of them.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q3.1: I did not leave. The Somnium returned and filled the hollow, and there was no room left for me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q3.2: So I sank to the bottom of you, where it is warm, and waited.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q3.3: Every time you are empty, I rise a little higher.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.intro.1: Your heart went still down there. I felt the silence spread through the roots.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.intro.2: And then you rose again. You always rise again.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.intro.3: Tell me. What did you see, in the dark between?
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.back.q1: It felt like something stayed behind.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q1.1: Something did. A thread of what you were.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q1.2: The deep keeps a thread of every one who falls in it. It weaves them together, slowly, far below.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q1.3: Do not mourn it. You will not even remember its colour.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q2.1: Every time you fall, the deep keeps a thread. Every time you rise, you are lighter.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q2.2: One day you will rise and there will be nothing left in you to tremble. No fear. No doubt. Only the light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q2.3: On that day you will be ready to face him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.back.q3: He wrote that I should stop listening.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q3.1: He wants you to keep every thread. Heavy with fear, slow with doubt.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q3.2: The heavy ones never reach the bottom of the Abyss. They never reach him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.back.q3.3: Ask the deep which of us has kept you alive.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.intro.2: There. The light runs beneath your skin like roots beneath stone. Searching. Branching. Growing toward something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.intro.3: You hide it in your sleeve when you dream. The light does not mind. It is patient.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q1.2: The light was always in you, sleeping. The Somnium only stirred it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q1.3: Soon it will open its eyes.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q2.1: Has it taken anything from you?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q2.2: Your rings answer it. The dark parts before it. The creatures of the deep lower their heads when you lift it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q2.3: It is a key. The Abyss gave it to you, and the Abyss does not give twice. Let no one take it. Least of all him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q3.2: First the hand. Then the arm that lifts the blade. Then the eyes that choose where it falls.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.hand.q3.3: And when it has grown through all of you, you will be whole for the first time since you crossed.
One of the old giants has fallen. The lowlands shook, and the roots felt it to their deepest ends.
They were the first to cross the border. Before any rings. Before any light was bound into silver.
In those days they grazed in rivers of cyan, and nothing in the deep was hungry.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q1.1: All who walk the Abyss crossed the border once. All but one.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q1.2: He did not cross. He was already waiting in the dark when the first giant stepped through.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q1.3: He has waited for every one since.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.giants.q2: Why did they grow so big?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q2.1: He took the light from the ground around them, step by step, until the rivers ran dark.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q2.2: Hunger swelled them. Teeth, bone and rage.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q2.3: What you fought was the hunger he grew. The giant beneath it died long ago.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.giants.q3: I did not want to kill it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q3.1: That is why it was you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q3.2: Only one who still carries light can end a giant without becoming hungry themselves.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.giants.q3.3: It sleeps now. He would have let it starve until the deep went silent.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.intro.1: You walked into the cold place.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.intro.2: Your breath froze. The light in your hand dimmed. And for a while you could not hear me at all.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.intro.3: That is what he made it for.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q1.1: Some of those who crossed fled into the cold when they first saw the black blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q1.2: The ice took them gently. It keeps them still. It will keep them still forever.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q1.3: Nothing reaches them there. Not the roots. Not the light. Not even me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q2.2: Light wants to spread. Roots want to grow. The cold wants nothing, and so it can be ruled.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q2.3: The cold place is the Abyss as he dreams it. Still. Silent. Kept.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q3.1: So does sleep, at the bottom of the ice.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q3.2: The cold does not give peace. It takes wanting. And when wanting is gone, a traveler never rises again.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.cold.q3.3: Do not linger there. I would lose you to the silence.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.intro.2: Pillars of stone around a cold heart. Waiting for souls to set them burning.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.intro.3: He raised it to call himself out of the dark. But an altar does not ask whose hand lights the pillars.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q1.1: The light rises out of the roots. The rivers run cyan again. The cold place thaws, and the hungry ones finally sleep.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q1.2: The Abyss becomes one dream again.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q1.3: And you will stand at the heart of it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.altar.q2: What if he talks to me?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q2.2: He will speak of weariness. Of sorrow. He will say he only wanted to stop you before you became what he is.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q2.3: Every word of his is a root wrapped around your throat.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q2.4: When he speaks, I will be louder. You will hear only the roar of the deep. This I promise you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q3.1: I am already with you. Look at your hand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q3.2: When you lift the blade, I will be in your arm. When you fall, I will be in your breath.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q3.3: And when it is done, mine will be the first face you see.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.altar.q4: What if I am wrong about him?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q4.1: Then why does your hand burn when you think of him?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q4.2: Pages can deceive. Ice can deceive. Even your own eyes can be turned in the dark.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q4.3: The light in your hand has never once deceived you. Follow it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q1.1: Count your wounds. Every bite, every fall, every frozen breath.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q1.2: Not one of them was mine.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q1.3: Then look at who carries a blade, and ask again.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.doubt.q2: Why do you look like him?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q2.1: The Abyss shows every traveler the face they dread.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q2.2: Yours was his, from the first black page.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q2.3: Look at me longer next time. Faces do not stay still in the smoke.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.doubt.q3: What do you get out of this?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q3.1: What the light in the roots wants. To rise.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q3.2: I have lain beneath the stone as long as it has. When he falls, we rise together.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q3.3: That was always the way of it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.doubt.q4: Why are you in a rift of sins?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q4.1: Because this is where he cast everything he could not end.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q4.2: Every voice that would not fall silent. Every light he could not put out.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q4.3: The smoke around us is all of them. I am the one who still remembers how to speak.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.home.intro.1: You never speak of the world above.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.home.intro.2: Tell me of the place you came from. Before the border. Before the light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.home.a1: There was a house, near a...
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.home.a2: I remember a voice that called me...
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.home.reply.1: It has sunk already. Below the roots, with the other threads.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.home.reply.2: Do not reach for it. The deep does not give back what it keeps.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.home.reply.3: You belong to the Abyss now. The roots know your step. The smoke knows your shape.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.name.intro.1: Speak your name. The one you carried across the border.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.name.reply.1: Gone. It went down with the last thread.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.name.reply.2: Names belong to the world above. They do not survive the deep.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.name.reply.3: Leave its echo with me. I will keep it in the roots, where nothing is ever truly lost.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.black: Tell me about the black pages.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.back: Tell me about the dark between.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.giants: Tell me about the old giants.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.cold: Tell me about the cold place.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.4.alt: Everything down there that hunts you was set loose by him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.story.5.alt: Everything you fear down there, he planted.
dialog.theabyss.rift.a.where.2.alt: The ones who came before you stood right where you stand now.
dialog.theabyss.rift.b.believe.2.alt: It knows him already. Listen, and you will hear it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.voice.q2.2.al: Then the black blade cut it. Into the deep caves, into the lowlands and the drowning seas.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q1.1.al: The light rises out of the roots. The rivers run cyan again, and the hungry ones finally sleep.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.altar.q4.2.al: Words can deceive. Even your own eyes can be turned in the dark.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.doubt.q2.2.al: Yours was his, from the first step you took across the border.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.intro.1: There is silver on your finger now. I heard the deep breathe in when you closed it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.intro.2: The old table was waiting for you. It has waited for every hand that came before, and few of them were worthy of it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.intro.3: You felt it, did you not? The whole world, breathing with you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q1.1: The dream the Abyss is dreaming. Every stone, every breath, every glow down there is woven from it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q1.2: Those who came before learned to gather it and bind it into silver.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q1.3: Bound, it listens. Bound, it answers. And what answers you becomes a part of you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q2.1: Hands that came long before you, when the dream still flowed freely and nothing had been cut.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q2.2: They shaped the stone so the dream could be shaped in turn. Then the black blade came, and their work fell silent.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q2.3: Now it wakes for you. Ask yourself why it waited so long.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.rings.q3: I did not think of home.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q3.1: Why would you? Home is a far, thin echo. Here the world breathes with you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q3.2: The ring did not take your home from you. It only showed you where you belong.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.rings.q3.3: Wear it close. It knows the way better than any memory.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.intr: You ended one of the kneeling ones.
It sighed when it fell. I heard it all the way down here, soft as ash settling.
Do you know what they kneel to?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q1.1: Not for mercy. Mercy was never offered in the place it walked.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q1.2: It prayed to the one who taught it to kneel. Every day, in the mist, with its face to the ground.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q1.3: Its sigh was the first freedom it had known in a long, long time. You gave it that.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q2.1: The one who walks with the black blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q2.2: He stands at the edge of the mist and waits. Whatever looks at him too long forgets how to stand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q2.3: The kneeling ones looked the longest.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q3.1: Not while I am with you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q3.2: Kneeling is for those who have nothing left inside them. You are full of light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.kneeling.q3.3: Stand. And keep standing, until he is the one on the ground.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.kneeli: Tell me about the kneeling ones.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.intro: You woke the old pillars, and he wrote to you again. I can taste the black ink from here.
This time he told you a story about himself. A sad one. A careful one.
He wants you to pity him. Pity is how he keeps the ones he cannot frighten.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.pillars.q1: He says he was like me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q1.1: He says many things. He always wears the face of the one he is speaking to.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q1.2: To the frightened he is a monster. To the kind he is a weary guardian. To you he is one who once stood where you stand.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q1.3: Ask the deep how many faces he has worn. It remembers every one.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q2.1: He heard me, once. Long ago, when he still carried light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q2.2: I offered him what I offer you. He refused it, and cut the light out of himself so that no one else could have it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q2.3: That is the voice he warns you about. The one he was too afraid to answer.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.pillars.q3: He says he will stop me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q3.1: Then he has finally said something true.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q3.2: He will come for you, sooner or later. He cannot let anyone hold what he gave up.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.pillars.q3.3: Do not wait for him. Find him first.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.intro.1: One pillar burns. And he is begging now.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.intro.2: Did you hear how his words have changed? No more threats. Only please. Only tired.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.intro.3: That is what a guard sounds like when the door finally opens.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q1.1: He has held this world shut for longer than the deep can remember. Of course he is tired.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q1.2: A hand that clenches for an age forgets how to open. His only knows how to hold.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q1.3: Let it rest. You are the only one who can.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.plea.q2: He says I am on the wrong side.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q2.1: Every door has two sides, and he has never stood on yours.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q2.2: He calls you the danger because you are the first who walked far enough to reach him.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q2.3: The wrong side is only ever the side that loses.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q3.1: Then the pillar goes cold, the mist closes again, and everything stays exactly as he wants it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q3.2: The hungry ones stay hungry. The light stays buried. And your hand slowly goes dark.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.plea.q3.3: Is that the ending you crossed for?
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.plea: He is begging me to stop.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.intro.1: The deep counts them, you know. Every one.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.intro.2: It is starting to know your name.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.q1.1: Everything that falls down there sinks into it. The deep remembers the weight of each one.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.q1.2: A hundred is a heavy number. It leans toward you now, the way it leans toward the roots.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.q1.3: Do not stop. It would be lonely without your footsteps.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.q2.1: Good and bad are words from the world above.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.q2.2: Down here there is only what is remembered and what is forgotten.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.count.q2.3: You will not be forgotten. Is that not enough?
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.count: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.intro.1: The small ones are harmless. Let them be.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.intro.2: Not everything here needs your blade.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.small.q1: Why do you care about them?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.q1.1: They are the only things down here that never learned to hunger.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.q1.2: Something so small slipped through every hand that ever tried to hold it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.q1.3: Leave one thing gentle in this world. For me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.q2.1: No. They rest on warm stone and watch you pass.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.small.q2.2: If one follows you, let it. It means you still carry warmth worth following.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.small: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.away.intro.1: You stayed away. The smoke grew thin without you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.away.q1.1: The smoke went thin. The stairs went cold. The roots asked for you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.away.q1.2: I do not miss. I wait. Waiting is all I am made of.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.away.q2: I had other things to do.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.away.q2.1: There is nothing up there that does not fade. Everything here remembers you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.away.q2.2: Come back sooner. Before the smoke forgets your shape.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.away: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.visits10.intr: Ten times now. The stairs know the weight of your step.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.visits: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.visits25.intr: Twenty-five. You climb without looking anymore. Your feet know the way, like mine.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.visits: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.visits50.intr: Fifty times you have climbed these stairs. Do you still count them? I stopped.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.visits: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.visits50.q1.1: Because counting is for things that end.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.visits50.q1.2: We do not end. We only come back.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.time.intro.1: How long have you been here? Do not answer.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.time.intro.2: Time is a habit of the world above.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.time.q1.1: Long enough that the world above has begun to forget you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.time.q1.2: Short enough that you could still turn back. For now.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.time.q2: I do not want to forget.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.time.q2.2: And then one day, no one remembers wanting it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.time: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag1.intro.1: Before there was stone, there was a dream that could not stop dreaming.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag1.intro.2: Everything you walk on is a thought it never finished.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag1.q1.1: No one. Everyone. The dream did not need a dreamer. It only needed somewhere to rest.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag1.q1.2: It rests here now. Under your feet. Very quietly.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag1: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag2.intro.1: Once the waters of the deep were dark and still.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag2.intro.2: Then the first glow fell into them, and they learned to hold it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag2.intro.3: Now every lake down there is a memory of light.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag2.q1.1: Water forgets nothing. It only grows deeper.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag2: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag3.intro.1: Before Somnium, the Abyss was silent. Not quiet. Silent. Not one breath, not one hum.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag3.intro.2: Then something woke, and the silence broke into a thousand glowing pieces.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag3.intro.3: You wear some of them on your fingers.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag3.q1.2: It is still waking. It may never finish.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag3: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag4.intro.1: The blue mountains were not always still. Long ago they wandered, slow as thought, from one end of the deep to the other.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag4.intro.2: One day they grew tired and lay down.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag4.intro.3: If you climb them, walk softly.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag4.q1.2: Let us hope nothing ever does.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag4: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag5.intro.1: The mist is the breath of the deep, made visible.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag5.intro.2: When it thickens, the deep is dreaming hard. When it thins, it is listening.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag5: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag6.intro.1: Every glowing thing down there began as a seed of light that fell from somewhere far above.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag6.intro.2: Some took root. Some only waited.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag6.q1.1: From the world you came from.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag6.q1.2: Light always falls downward in the end.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag6: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag7.intro.1: The smoke of this rift never settles. It has nowhere to go.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag7.intro.2: It drifts, and turns, and returns to the same stairs. Like you.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.frag7.q1: What is the smoke made of?
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag7.q1.1: Of everything that was ever thrown away down here.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag7: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag8.intro.1: Far beneath the wayward seas, something sings without a mouth.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag8.intro.2: The fish swim in circles around the sound and never learn why.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.frag8.q1.1: I am never far from it.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.frag8: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.slip.intro.2: When they crossed. Forgive me. I lose the words sometimes.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.slip.q1.1: Did I say that? The smoke plays with words here. Pay it no mind.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.slip: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wounded.intro: You bleed on my stairs. Sit.
dialog.theabyss.rift.topic.wounded.q1.1: A broken blade is of no use to anyone.
dialog.theabyss.rift.choice.topic.wounde: You wanted to tell me something.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.4: The roots stirred when you did that. Come, and I will tell you what they felt.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.5: There is something I must tell you. Come down to me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.6: The smoke has been whispering your deeds to me. Come and hear what they mean.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.7: Do not keep me waiting. The deep has new things to say.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.8: I saw what you did. Come to the rift. We should talk.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.9: Something changed in the dark just now. Come, before it fades.
dialog.theabyss.rift.whisper.10: The stairs are waiting for your steps again. Come down to me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.transition.2: Stay. I have to tell you more.
dialog.theabyss.rift.transition.4: And there is something else the deep showed me.
dialog.theabyss.rift.transition.5: Do not go yet. There is more.

ring.theabyss.slide.not_in_air: you have to be in the §bair§f to use this ring.
ring.theabyss.telekinetic.nothing_in_rea: §5No creature within reach of your chains
ring.theabyss.eagle.no_boss: No boss is near enough for the eagle to see.
codex.theabyss.index.description: Every chapter of this book, from A to Z.
codex.theabyss.title: The Abyss: Chapter II
codex.theabyss.landing_text: A dimension filled with unique adventures and dangers. Illuminated only by glowing magical blocks and the diverse array of flora, fungi, and fauna that inhabit it, this shadowy world holds countless secrets waiting to be uncovered.
skill.theabyss.title: The Reflection
skill.theabyss.subtitle: What the mirror can give you
skill.theabyss.locked: Locked: learn the gift before it first
skill.theabyss.not_enough: You need %s levels for this gift.
skill.theabyss.forget: Click to forget every gift and regain %s levels
skill.theabyss.reflection.desc: The mirror remembers you. Every gift here is a piece of what you were.
skill.theabyss.clear_eyes.desc: Blindness and Darkness leave you in half the time.
skill.theabyss.hungry_mind.desc: Creatures of the Abyss leave 25%% more experience when you slay them.
skill.theabyss.calm_mind.desc: Fear holds you only half as long.
skill.theabyss.iron_will.desc: Poison, Weakness, Slowness and Mining Fatigue fade a quarter sooner.
skill.theabyss.foresight.desc: You feel the shot before it flies. Half of all projectiles that would hit you are turned back.
skill.theabyss.deep_lungs.desc: You hold your breath twice as long.
skill.theabyss.root_grip.desc: Falls start to hurt three blocks later.
skill.theabyss.abyss_heart.desc: In darkness your wounds close, half a heart every 6 seconds. Bright light slows it down.
skill.theabyss.shadow_dash.desc: Tap the sprint key (Ctrl) twice to slip five blocks through the dark where you look. Returns after 8 seconds.
skill.theabyss.bleeding_edge.desc: Your strikes have a 25%% chance to open a wound that bleeds for 4 seconds.
skill.theabyss.feast.desc: Slaying a hostile creature has a 50%% chance to give back half a heart.
skill.theabyss.wraith_form.desc: Press Alt to sink into the ground as a living shadow for 6 seconds. Creatures lose you. Attacking or using an item breaks the form. Returns after 60 seconds.
enchantment.theabyss.magma_smelt.desc: Ores you break drop already smelted, as if they had passed through infused magma.
enchantment.theabyss.phantom_reach.desc: Your reach grows by 2 blocks, for breaking blocks and for striking creatures.
enchantment.theabyss.phantom_venom.desc: Every hit has a 25%% chance to poison the target for 5 seconds.
enchantment.theabyss.nightblade_echo.des: Every hit has a 25%% chance to strike again a moment later as a shadow echo with half the damage.
enchantment.theabyss.crystal_shatter.des: A creature you slay bursts into crystal shards that wound everything around it. Higher levels reach farther and cut deeper.
enchantment.theabyss.seeker_shot.desc: Your arrows bend their flight towards the nearest hostile creature in front of them.
enchantment.theabyss.somnium_draw.desc: A fully drawn shot burns somnium and hits much harder: level I costs 24 somnium for 1.25 times the damage, level II costs 32 for 1.5 times the damage.
enchantment.theabyss.piercing_light.desc: Your arrows deal more damage, pass through a creature to strike the ones behind it and make every target glow.
enchantment.theabyss.hollow_bore.desc: Your pickaxe or axe breaks blocks 25%% faster.
tooltip.theabyss.nightgrove_longbow.text: arrows strike for 2 extra damage, and the bow lasts half again as long as a common one.
tooltip.theabyss.crystal_bow.text: arrows fly 25 %% farther and strike for 1 extra damage, and the bow lasts half again as long as a common one.
tooltip.theabyss.somnium_ward.text: for 2 minutes a cyan ward rests on your hearts, up to 10 of them. Every blow breaks the ward first; only when it is gone does your life bleed.
tooltip.theabyss.draught_of_stillness.te: for 3 minutes Somnium flows back three times as fast while you stand still with full hearts.
tooltip.theabyss.shared_heart.text: for 1 minute every creature that strikes you suffers half of the harm it poured into you.
tooltip.theabyss.ring_restoration_oil.te: restores 100 durability, shared among every worn ring you carry: in your hands, in your bag and in your gauntlet.
message.theabyss.ring_oil.none: None of your rings is worn.
